name: Seeded Local Community Detection
problem_statement: Find a nontrivial low-conductance vertex subset containing a specified seed set.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: maximum_volume
problem_inputs.description: Optional upper bound on selected weighted degree volume.

required_outputs.name: conductance
required_outputs.description: cut(S,V-S)/min(vol(S),vol(V-S)); null when denominator is zero.

required_outputs.name: optimal
required_outputs.description: Whether global constrained optimality was proven.

solution_semantics.objective: Find a seed-containing community of low conductance under the volume constraint.
solution_semantics.exactness: Typical diffusion-and-sweep methods are heuristic; diffusion scores alone are an incomplete implementation of this contract.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

edge_cases: Disconnected zero-cut communities may have conductance zero.
No feasible nontrivial set must be reported explicitly.
